title: Art in America Magazine September 1988 - Very Good
descriptionText: This is a September 1988 issue of Art in America magazine, featuring articles on Nadar, Nauman, and Spain's art scene in Miami. The magazine is in physical format and is illustrated, with a monthly publication frequency. The contributors are multi and the distribution is paid circulation. The magazine is in English and is categorized under Books & Magazines and Magazines, specifically Art in America.
